description: A map between finite free-name contexts renames every free occurrence of an infinitary formula and retains every protected bound slot.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.relabel.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {β : Type w'} [Finite α] [Finite β] (f : α → β) {n : ℕ} :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α n →
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L β n
